question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"serious."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Serious"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • It is an adjective that means important, significant, or severe. (गंभीरता से (न कि हलके से) लिया जाने योग्‍य) • **Example:***** **Don’t laugh, it’s a **serious**__ matter.* • The sentence suggests that the blank requires a word that describes the nature of the situation, indicating that something significant or severe is happening. • Grammatically, the word **"serious"** fits in the sentence structure as an adjective modifying the noun **(obstacle)** that follows it. • The correct answer is Option 4. • Correct paragraph: Literacy is a very important quality of a population. __Only__ an informed and educated citizen can make __intelligent__ choices and undertake research and development __projects__. Low levels of literacy are a __**serious**__ obstacle for economic improvement. In India, ______ (5) ______ has been a steady improvement in the literacy levels. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 1, **"minor"**, means something small or unimportant and does not fit the context of the sentence. (जो अधिक बड़ा, गंभीर या आवश्‍यक न हो (औरों की तुलना में), गौण, छोटा, कम महत्वपूर्ण) • Option 2,** "new"**, means something recently created or discovered and does not fit the context of the sentence. (नया (बना, खोजा आदि)) • Option 3, **"biggest"**, means the largest or most significant (बड़ा, विशाल) and could be a possible choice, but** "serious"** is a better fit for the context of the sentence. 96:Te86, The correct answer is **"there."**
